stem: The United States acquired the Oregon Territory when —

options.label: A
options.text: a treaty divided U.S. and British claims to the land

options.label: B
options.text: Mexico sold the territory to the United States for $10 million

options.label: C
options.text: the territory’s settlers voted for annexation by the United States

options.label: D
options.text: Russia sold the land to the United States for $7.2 million
